_about: Template for the local, untracked config/callers.json — copy it there and replace the sample caller ids with the threads this workspace actually runs. A caller is the named thread doing the work, claimed at the wrapper seams (--caller flag, or $COLAB_CALLER for drivers) and validated against this registry; the machinery callers (panel, standing, test, lease) are code constants and never listed here. A caller may carry one lane suffix (alpha-thread:lane-1) validated against its registered base. The optional "active" list marks registered callers whose work is detached-only: active means a potential use for Colab exists for that caller even when no session is currently up, and while a caller is marked active the sync gate refuses its synchronous attaches outright — it launches detached and polls instead. The optional "programmes" object declares, per registered caller, the programme its runs are reported under (the transport adoption report reads it through the lease core's callers module); a caller with no declaration reports under its own name, and a lane suffix inherits its base's declaration.
